integration.normalization: integral over 4pi steradians equals one per RGB band
integration.convention: cosTheta=1 is zero-deflection forward scattering; negate a direction-to-light vector when forming the incident propagation vector

provenance.license: Original generated numerical asset; repository license applies.
provenance.liquid: Polydisperse Lorenz-Mie calculation implemented by this generator; Hansen modified-gamma size distribution with effective variance 0.10.
provenance.ice: Original normalized multi-lobe approximation informed by Yang et al. (2013) habit/roughness behavior; not a substitute for the Yang/Baum numerical database.
provenance.analyticFit: Energy-normalized HG + Draine + weak backward-HG closure with deterministic continuous parameter refinement and first-moment penalty.

limitations: Ice phase functions are physically constrained analytic approximations, not full electromagnetic solutions.
Random particle orientation is assumed; oriented plate/column halo arcs require a separate orientation model.
The positive RGB band responses are display-oriented approximations rather than a full CIE spectral transform.
Polarization and thermal-infrared absorption are outside this visible-light asset.
Sub-degree diffraction structure is represented mainly by the analytic forward lobe because the LUT has finite angular resolution.
